theory.note: sigma^pred(Z/gamma* -> tautau, 60 < m_LHE < 120) = 6077.22 pb (FEWZ NNLO, all flavours) x sumw(LHE tautau, 60-120) / sumw of the aMC@NLO DYJetsToLL_M-50 sample (z-tautau/docs/06, fitting/CONVENTIONS.md section 6). The repository documents no PDF + scale + alpha_s uncertainty on this number (only on the acceptance A: 3.7 %, and on the mumu reference 1953.9 pb the 0.47 % definitional spread; the documents searched are listed in provenance.theory_searched), so unc_up / unc_down carry the relative uncertainty of the published NNLO+NNLL prediction of the same quantity with the same PDF family (unc_source); the two central values agree to 0.25 %
